fusions.name: Herding Sweep
fusions.desc: You swing the staff wide through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Crook for Stragglers
fusions.desc: You reach the staff out to rap an enemy up to 5 tiles away for 7 damage, up to 1.4 times that at full reach, and 8% more for each ally near you, up to 32%. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gathered Close
fusions.desc: You thump the staff to call your allies in, restoring 16 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Barn-Warm Company
fusions.desc: Every hit you land with the staff builds a stack of shared warmth on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
